hook: A much shorter Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.
hookText: A much shorter Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis

beats.say: This is a Lean 4 proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions.
It is built on Mathlib and uses only three axioms, and it follows Levent Alpoge's approach in a shorter version made with Anthropic colleagues and Claude.
A build takes one to two hours on twelve cores with twenty-four gigabytes of memory, or about eighty-five minutes more without the Mathlib cache.
